verses.english: “For insight into greed, ten things should be developed.

verses.pali: Sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi, sammāñāṇaṁ, sammāvimutti—
verses.english: Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these ten things should be developed.”
